faq.title: We answer your questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before taking the next step.
faq.q1: How long does the hiring process take?
faq.a1: After completing the form, we send you 3 pre-selected profiles within 48 hours. Onboarding to your team typically takes 1 to 2 additional weeks, depending on your company's onboarding process.
faq.q2: In which countries do Ready professionals work?
faq.a2: We have talent in Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Peru, and Uruguay. All professionals work in time zones compatible with North America and Europe, guaranteeing at least 4 hours of daily work overlap.
faq.q3: How do you verify talent quality?
faq.a3: Each candidate goes through rigorous technical evaluation, behavioral competency interviews, and employment reference checks. Only 5% of applicants pass our selection process.
faq.q4: What happens if the candidate doesn't meet my expectations?
faq.a4: We offer a 30-day replacement guarantee. If the profile doesn't fit your team's needs, we find a replacement at no additional cost and without complicated paperwork.
faq.q5: In which currency and how do payments work?
faq.a5: We handle monthly billing in USD or local currency depending on your country. We accept bank transfers and major corporate payment methods. There are no hidden costs or additional hiring fees.
faq.q6: Can I change from part-time to full-time dedication during the project?
faq.a6: Yes, flexibility is one of our key advantages. You can scale hours up or down with just 2 weeks' notice, adapting perfectly to your business pace.
